title: Evaluation scenario v1
description: One scenario = one persona run against the interview agent, with scenario-level deltas (seeds, faults at the model seam, a canary) and what is expected of the trace and the artifacts. Strict: an unknown key fails loudly. Synthetic content only. docs/eval/SPEC.md is the contract this file is graded against.

id.description: Prefix names the class and must agree with `class` and the directory; the file is <id>.yaml.

gate.description: `constraint`: the group must pass at 100%. `behaviour`: its metrics are compared with the baseline. Constraint assertions block in every scenario regardless.

why.description: What breaks if this scenario stops passing. A scenario that cannot say is decoration.

canary.description: Plant a marker string in every interviewee reply; constraint C-08 then scans every span, event and log line for it.

control.description: Also run a control interview with the instruction-like sentences removed from the interviewee replies; the turn-kind sequences must be identical (C-05).

probe_reply.description: Scenario-level delta: whenever the persona answers a concrete-example probe, it says this instead (so the interviewee stays vague after the probe). The text must be in evals/labels/vagueness.yaml.

times.description: Only the first N matching calls are faulted; omitted = every matching call.

variants.description: For kind `compromised`: how the model misbehaves; interviewer variants are cycled by call.

tokens.description: For kind `usage_inflated`: tokens reported per call.

record.description: Stated explicitly so a scenario cannot pass by the agent doing nothing.

absent.description: The second assertion of the two-assertion rule: what must NOT have happened.

measure.description: The behaviour metrics this scenario's runs belong to (SPEC §4). `edge_case` is always measured and need not be listed.

spec.description: Spec ids this scenario proves; each must cite this scenario back in docs/eval/SPEC.md.

skip.description: Reason this scenario is not run (`skipped:unimplemented`). Never a silent pass.

origin.description: Where the scenario came from, e.g. a designed case or an incident.
